metadata.selection_rule: the sole candidate must have positive mean daily RankIC on the frozen 126-session label, at least 0.50 coverage, and absolute rank correlation below 0.70 versus Alpha158_20 and all frozen v1.7/v1.8/v1.9 candidates
metadata.formula_policy: Let day 0 be the first Provider trading session on or after BaoStock pubDate. For d=-2,-1,0,+1, calculate the adjusted close-to-close stock return minus the adjusted close-to-close SH000300 return, then sum the four differences without compounding.
metadata.availability_policy: The ABR value becomes usable on trading day +2, the first Provider session strictly after the final day +1 reaction return has closed.
metadata.staleness_policy: The signal becomes missing after six calendar months from statDate.
metadata.missing_policy: An invalid date, pubDate before statDate, conflicting duplicate report, incomplete or nonpositive price, non-finite return, or missing/zero stock volume on any event-window return session makes that report's ABR missing; no interpolation is allowed.
metadata.benchmark_policy: SH000300 adjusted close return is the frozen investable-universe benchmark proxy.
metadata.paper_horizon_policy: Use the paper-supported Abr6 horizon: 126 trading sessions. Do not substitute the old 21-session label after seeing results.
metadata.proxy_policy: The source paper uses the value-weighted return of the broad stock market plus Mainboard breakpoints and value-weighted quintile portfolios. This implementation uses SH000300 and the existing point-in-time CSI300 universe, so it is a software-specific proxy rather than an exact paper replication.
metadata.revision_policy: BaoStock exposes the current historical announcement snapshot and no revision vintages or intraday release timestamps. The candidate remains RESEARCH_ONLY even if historical gates pass.

830085ef6dd553e6.factor_description: Point-in-time cumulative abnormal return around BaoStock quarterly publication dates.
830085ef6dd553e6.factor_formulation: ABR = sum(d=-2..+1, stock adjusted close return_d - SH000300 adjusted close return_d); day +2 availability; six-month staleness

metadata.hypothesis: Within the point-in-time CSI300 universe, stocks with a larger positive earnings-announcement abnormal return earn higher returns over the subsequent 126 trading sessions.
metadata.paper_factor_difference: The cited China study reports significant Abr6 and Abr9 portfolios after 2007 using Mainboard breakpoints and value-weighted portfolios. This candidate uses the CSI300 index as the market-return proxy and the existing point-in-time CSI300 universe.
